name: Google ADK DatabaseSessionService
description: ADK session and state persistence in a relational database (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite via async driver). Session state, user: state (per user across sessions) and app: state (per app) persist; temp: state never persists.

provenance.notes: Supports backing_type relational ('Connects to a relational database (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite)') and delete_session. memory_type session is the primary use; user: and app: prefixes also persist across sessions (adk.dev/sessions/state/), which v1 memory_type cannot express.
